what_it_does: Adapts Tensor Cores (specialized matrix-multiplication hardware on NVIDIA GPUs like the A100 and H100) to accelerate molecular docking—the computational chemistry problem of finding how drug molecules bind to protein targets. Molecular docking has irregular, sparse computation patterns (not the dense matrix operations Tensor Cores were designed for), so the paper develops techniques to sum up partial results efficiently using Tensor Cores and applies numerical error correction to keep answers accurate despite the irregular workload.
